subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The jewel thief was punished by the judge.

options.text: Punishment had been given to jewel thief.
The police had punished the jewel thief.
The judge punished the jewel thief.
Punishment was given to jewel thief.

solution:
The correct answer is **The judge punished the jewel thief**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **passive voice**. We have to change the sentence into the **active form**. 

 The given sentence is written in** 'simple past tense' **form. 
 
• The sentence structure in the Simple past tense is as follows: 
 
 
• Passive: Object + was/were + V3 + by + Subject.
 
• ​**Active:** Subject + V2 + Object.
 
 
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• Passive: This beautiful necklace was brought by Renu.
 
• ** ****Active: **Renu brought this beautiful necklace.
 
 
 
• The object of the given sentence is **'The jewel thief' **and the subject of the given sentence is** 'the judge.'**
 
• So, in the active voice, the position of **‘object’ **and **‘subject’ **will be interchanged and 'by' will be removed. 
 
• Also here,** 'was punished' **will be changed into** 'punished.'**
 
• Thus, the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice is **option 3**.

**Correct Active Voice:**__ *The judge punished the jewel thief.*
